reviewerValidation.actualMacExecution: NOT_EXECUTED for these revised bytes in this review; 14 Darwin tests skipped on Linux.

resolvedFindings.issue: Direct waitid assumptions and zombie-only process-group signal-zero expectations did not match the existing Darwin compatibility contract.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The test now uses the existing WNOWAIT child_status helper, stdin-gated live child, exact child identity, bounded exit-pending observation, individual signal-zero success, process-group EPERM, retained zombie inventory and exact wait/reap before group-gone verification.
resolvedFindings.remainingGate: Execute this actual Mac test with zero skips.

resolvedFindings.issue: An early exact-child cleanup error could stop later child cleanup or replace the primary failure.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Cleanup continues across every exact child, closes streams, retains fixed operation/error kinds, preserves the original pending exception, writes the safe receipt even on failure, and restores the original sampler in a nested finally.
resolvedFindings.regression: Two-child negative test verifies later wait after an earlier terminate PermissionError and preservation of the exact original OSError object.

apiAssessment.normalDarwinPrimary: A bounded Python child uses read-only sysctl KERN_PROC_PID for self-binding and KERN_PROC_PGRP for group records. There is no permission-triggered fallback.
apiAssessment.completeness: Size/data calls validate the 8 MiB cap and record-size multiples. ENOMEM data is discarded before fresh bounded size/data retries. Duplicate/invalid PID, birth, credentials or state rejects the inventory. Valid zombies and other-owner records are retained.
apiAssessment.selfBinding: The header-derived layout and source/binary/job binding are validated, then the exact helper PID/birth/EUID/RUID are compared across sysctl and libproc.
apiAssessment.arguments: Selectors and subjects require exact int types; bool, invalid selector and invalid subject inputs are rejected before any API call.
apiAssessment.resourceChecks: Existing task/BSD counters, PID generation, owner and current group membership checks remain authoritative. Inventory selection does not grant signal ownership.
apiAssessment.unknown: Denied, malformed, empty, missing-ABI and helper failures remain unavailable with null resource totals; they cannot certify zero usage or group exit.
apiAssessment.deadline: subprocess.run retains timeout=3 with exact helper kill/reap, the existing three-attempt sampler and two 0.25-second retry gaps. Process creation and cleanup overhead are outside the communicate timeout; this is not a strict 9.5-second wall-clock bound.
apiAssessment.bootstrap: Explicit ps bootstrap is limited to census-abi-compile and census-abi. The flag resets in finally; normal stages with a missing/invalid ABI fail without ps fallback.
apiAssessment.privateProtocol: Raw PIDs/group identifiers stay in the bounded private helper protocol. Public diagnostics retain fixed allowlisted phases/error types/queries/errno/lengths only. The helper receives allowlisted environment keys, not tokens or arbitrary job environment.

stress.required: At least 20 samples; all returned samples complete; native helper backend only; zero inventory timeout attempts; measured peak RSS at least 2048 MiB; measured CPU at least 20 seconds; natural worker completion and exact worker/churn reaps; monitored group verified gone, leader exit zero and no cleanup failure.

actualMacRequiredGate.receipt: FirstFailure and monitorFailure must be null; safe result must be passed. Missing or failed receipts fail the job.

run26Evidence.independentChecks: Read-only run/job/artifact API metadata and the decoded producer report were compared with the retained receipt. The first failure, monitor failure and both retained stages matched.
run26Evidence.interpretation: The observed stop was an inventory-monitor failure. It does not establish a compiler/product failure or the original native-host exit cause.

limitations: Kernel process enumeration is a changing snapshot, not proof of continuous or atomic process coverage; existing per-process identity and membership checks remain necessary.
The short approximately 4.5 GiB touched-memory load does not prove stability throughout a multi-hour Rust build or reproduce the original 7615 MiB observed peak.
The two early ABI preparation stages still use bootstrap ps inventory.
Successful short diagnostics do not establish checkpoint eligibility, full-build completion, native authentication or the historical native exit cause.
A long trial requires a separate decision after immutable short-job terminal evidence review.

primarySources.supports: KERN_PROC group filtering includes live/zombie iteration, accounts for required records and reports ENOMEM when the copy capacity is insufficient.
The alternative proc_listpids implementation has an independent internal nprocs-plus-slop allocation cap and was not selected as a complete enumeration contract.
